name: NGC 4206 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4206, an edge-on spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4206-hubble
story: Vast streaks of dust run along this edge-on spiral, some hiding its central bulge, while clumps near its edges mark places where stars are being born.

claims.text: NGC 4206 is an edge-on spiral galaxy
Vast streaks of dust, some obscuring the central bulge
Clumps near the edges mark areas where stars are being born
NGC 4206 was a target of a Hubble snapshot survey of nearby edge-on spiral galaxies
